scope: One combined new-delta correctness, clean-code, boundary and provenance pass; prior actual38 review 9a3385f390a7cbf53903a4562d1356f0051407fb45527cefe98a80e4b8ffdee6 reused. No unchanged kernel/control review, builds, tests, native campaigns, source edits or nested agents.
source_decision: The numerical statements implement the measured three-site correction requirements. One new factual source-comment finding remains; actual numerical acceptance is pending.

findings.kind: evidence attribution; no new numerical implementation defect identified
findings.problem: The new shared explanation says the original AND unmodified control narrow at 'those assignments'. Actual38 U/c does spill the slap value early and match FD1, but U/c retains the first right-pitch quotient through bound-plus-0.6 and fails FD12, just as the kernel and S/c do. The preceding phrase couples both sites and incorrectly promotes U's FD1 observation to FD12.
findings.evidence: Both i686 actual38 records: FD12 right pitch3 U/c and S/c are 0x3f8e147b versus the accepted canonical original Win64 0x3f8e147a. U and S assembly have fdivs, bound, faddl without first-assignment fstps. S STAGE(11) follows the second assignment. STATUS's new explanation already distinguishes this correctly.
findings.required_change: Qualify the narrowing contract as the accepted original Win64/SSE behavior, and make U's measured earlier float spill specific to FD1. Preserve that U is a surrogate and does not establish FD12 narrowing. A comment-only correction needs explicit source identity mapping; no numerical code or oracle change is requested.

inspected_facts: ROTOR_STORE_FLOAT evaluates its expression once into a function-local addressable volatile float, then reloads it into the destination. The macro has a scoped do/while body, no shared state, allocation, pointer exposure, new failure path or RNG operation.

Calls wrap the unchanged acc_force and first slap_amp expressions and the first left/right turbine-pitch divisions. This enforces the canonical f32 assignment boundaries before slap subtraction and before the subsequent turbine bound-plus-0.6. Left symmetry and acc_force narrowing follow the accepted Win64 float-assignment contract; current exact-target results must still establish all retained words.

The slap bound, looping-minus-slap, turbine bounds/additions, action order, masks and final output staging remain unchanged. This correction does not alter rotor_vector_magnitude or impose new numerical domains.

The local volatile double APU offset retains the original 0.2 value/type and occurs only on the original positive-APU branch. It prevents replacing the saturated bound-plus-offset with a pre-rounded float constant, so addition and final float assignment execute at runtime under the existing canonical scope.
All new floating operations are within the existing post-fp_save/fp_enter_canonical arithmetic scope. Integer ingress/egress, validation/refusal and full restoration code are byte-identical to38.
Header, oracle, controls, capture/build code, parser, target definitions, numerical flags, Core, ABI and every other tracked entry/mode are exact38. Existing oracles and assertions are not weakened.

STATUS and docs accurately label new source unbuilt/unrun at authoring, preserve older dd84 provenance, distinguish the U/S controls from oracles, and leave unmeasured other assignment/folding behavior and whole D3 open. Apart from the identified code-comment attribution, the new claims match the actual38 report.
